19410.subject: Technical Drawing
19410.question_text: Using the appropriate drawing tools, construct a perpendicular bisector of a line segment AB of length 80 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
19410.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 80 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc above and below AB with radius > 40 mm.
3. With B as center, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector.
5. Label the intersection point of AB and CD as M, the midpoint.

19411.subject: Technical Drawing
19411.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon of side 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines and label the vertices A, B, C, D, E, and F in order.
19411.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circle.
4. Join the points to form the hexagon.
5. Ensure all construction lines are visible and labeled.

19412.subject: Technical Drawing
19412.question_text: Construct an external tangent to two circles of radii 20 mm and 30 mm, with centers 70 mm apart. Show all construction lines and label the tangent points clearly.
19412.explanation:
1. Draw the two circles with centers O1 (20 mm radius) and O2 (30 mm radius), 70 mm apart.
2. Draw a line joining O1 and O2.
3. With O2 as center, draw a circle of radius = 30 mm - 20 mm = 10 mm.
4. Construct a tangent from O1 to this new circle.
5. Extend the tangent to meet the larger circle at T2.
6. Draw a line parallel to O1T1 from T2 to meet the smaller circle at T1.
7. Join T1 and T2 to form the external tangent.

19413.subject: Technical Drawing
19413.question_text:
Given the front elevation and plan of a block, draw the end elevation (right side view) to complete the orthographic projection. Assume first-angle projection. Dimensions are in millimeters.

Front Elevation: Rectangle 60 mm (width) × 40 mm (height).
Plan: Rectangle 60 mm (length) × 30 mm (width) with a semicircular cutout of radius 15 mm on the right side.
19413.explanation:
1. Draw the front elevation as a rectangle 60 mm × 40 mm.
2. Draw the plan as a rectangle 60 mm × 30 mm with a semicircle (R15 mm) on the right.
3. Project lines from the plan and front elevation to construct the end elevation.
4. The end elevation will show a rectangle 30 mm (width) × 40 mm (height) with a semicircular cutout (R15 mm) at the top.
5. Ensure all projection lines are visible and labeled.

19414.subject: Technical Drawing
19414.question_text: Draw a full sectional front elevation of the object shown in the given plan and incomplete front elevation. The section plane passes through the center of the object. Assume the object is a hollow cylinder with an external diameter of 50 mm, internal diameter of 30 mm, and height of 40 mm, with a rectangular slot 20 mm × 10 mm cut through the top half.
19414.explanation:
1. Draw the plan as two concentric circles (50 mm and 30 mm diameters).
2. Draw the front elevation as a rectangle 50 mm (width) × 40 mm (height) with a rectangular slot 20 mm × 10 mm.
3. For the sectional view, draw the front elevation with hatching to show the cut surface.
4. The section will reveal the hollow interior (30 mm diameter) and the slot.
5. Ensure hatching is at 45° and all dimensions are labeled.

19415.subject: Technical Drawing
19415.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 60 mm (length) × 30 mm (width) × 40 mm (height). Include a circular hole of diameter 20 mm drilled through the center of the top face. Show all construction lines.
19415.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Construct the block using the given dimensions.
3. On the top face, draw an ellipse (isometric circle) of diameter 20 mm.
4. Project the ellipse through the block to represent the hole.
5. Ensure all construction lines are visible and the isometric scale is maintained.

19416.subject: Technical Drawing
19416.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with a base diameter of 50 mm and slant height of 60 mm. Show all construction lines and label the development clearly.
19416.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi imes 50 = 157.08$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of a circle with radius = 60 mm (slant height) and arc length = 157.08 mm.
3. The sector angle $ heta$ is calculated as $ heta = rac{C}{2 imes \pi imes 60} imes 360° = 150°$.
4. Draw the sector with the calculated angle and radius.
5. Label the development and ensure all construction lines are visible.

19417.subject: Technical Drawing
19417.question_text: Draw the line of interpenetration between a vertical cylinder of diameter 40 mm and a horizontal cylinder of diameter 30 mm, where the axes intersect at right angles. Show the front elevation and plan.
19417.explanation:
1. Draw the front elevation and plan of both cylinders.
2. In the plan, the vertical cylinder appears as a circle (40 mm diameter), and the horizontal cylinder as a rectangle (30 mm width).
3. Project points from the plan to the front elevation to find the intersection curve.
4. The line of interpenetration will be a curved line in the front elevation.
5. Ensure all construction lines and points are labeled.

19418.subject: Technical Drawing
19418.question_text:
Dimension the following orthographic views of a simple bracket:
- Front elevation: Rectangle 80 mm (width) × 50 mm (height) with two holes of diameter 10 mm, 20 mm from the top and 20 mm from the sides.
- Plan: Rectangle 80 mm (length) × 30 mm (width) with the same two holes.
Apply standard dimensioning conventions.
19418.explanation:
1. Dimension the front elevation:
- Overall width: 80 mm.
- Overall height: 50 mm.
- Hole diameter: $\phi 10$ mm.
- Hole positions: 20 mm from top and sides.
2. Dimension the plan:
- Overall length: 80 mm.
- Overall width: 30 mm.
- Hole positions: 20 mm from sides and ends.
3. Use leader lines for hole dimensions and ensure no redundant dimensions.

19419.subject: Technical Drawing
19419.question_text:
Prepare a working drawing of a simple shaft coupling with the following details:
- Overall length: 120 mm.
- Diameter: 40 mm.
- Two flanges of diameter 60 mm and thickness 10 mm at both ends.
- Four holes of diameter 8 mm on each flange, equally spaced on a 50 mm pitch circle diameter.
Include front elevation (sectioned) and end elevation.
19419.explanation:
1. Draw the front elevation (sectioned):
- Shaft: 40 mm diameter × 120 mm length.
- Flanges: 60 mm diameter × 10 mm thickness at both ends.
- Holes: $\phi 8$ mm, equally spaced on a 50 mm PCD.
2. Draw the end elevation showing the flange with four holes.
3. Dimension all features using standard conventions.
4. Include a title block with necessary details.
